title: Practice spotting a scam
lede: Step through a fictional scam conversation, one message at a time. Nothing here is sent to anyone — it's a fixed set of scenarios built from real scam patterns.

objective.title: Your objective
objective.body: Notice the shift from a believable introduction to a request for money, credentials or control.

introTitle: A safe place to spot the pattern.
introBody: Advance one message at a time. Each fictional message comes with an explanation of the technique being used.

ended.title: Simulation ended
ended.headline: You've seen the pattern.
ended.advice: In a real conversation, stop before sharing a code or sending money. Verify through the institution's official app or a number you already trust.

fictionNote: Fictional messages. No messages are sent to anyone. No personal details are needed.
sourceLangNote: Scenario messages and tactic explanations are shown in the source language.
